name: walk_closed_umbrella
text: A person walks forward carrying a closed umbrella by its handle in the right hand beside the right thigh. Right elbow nearly straight and relaxed; the umbrella tip points down near the ground without scraping it. Left arm swings naturally. Keep moving steadily.
